finalText:
Migration's done. Twelve files were still on the old call and now match the rest of the codebase.

- `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `teamService.js` (accounts)
- `cohort.js` (analytics)
- `refund.js`, `couponService.js` (billing)
- `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js` (catalog)
- `shipment.js`, `returnService.js` (orders)
- `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js` (support)

One spot was left alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls the old form, but its own header says it's a vendored copy that's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits there get silently lost. Worth raising with whoever owns that vendor package separately.
